title: Wayfinder: interchangeable agent loops with Akh-owned services
description:
## Destination

Specify interchangeable Internal, Codex, Claude, Cursor and OpenCode loops behind Akh-owned sessions, tools, memory, workspace and execution services. Produce reviewed contracts, provider feasibility evidence and an implementation handoff.

## Notes

This Anima Plan is the Wayfinder map. Each individual Wayfinder decision or research item is a Work Item belonging to this Plan through plan_id. Dependencies are native Work Item dependency edges. There is no separate map Work Item.

The user has selected one loop fixed for each Akh. All sessions use that implementation with isolated conversation state. Loop changes while sessions exist remain undecided. Planning only: do not promote to a slice or dispatch implementation.

Local map and assets: docs/wayfinder/agent-loops/map.md and docs/wayfinder/agent-loops/assets/.

## Decisions so far

The loop-selection subdecision is recorded in Session ownership and loop selection. No full decision ticket has been closed.

## Not yet specified

Provider execution isolation, session lifecycle, composition and persistence details remain in the individual Work Items.

## Out of scope

Adapter implementation/deployment, credential migration and replacing Akh execution backends.
